channel.title: Ayahuasca-Lore on The New Jungle Tribe
channel.description: Recent content in Ayahuasca-Lore on The New Jungle Tribe

item.title: Ayahuasca Origin
item.description: The origin of things. Hard to find when the beginning is something we don’t think it exists. Continuation, more like it. The one who passed the medicine is the same who tried to defend it. A loyal servant to Gaia. He was in charge to protect and make it available for humans and keep the legacy on. Soon to be forgotten. He’d later realize that humans not only are danger, but the ones who would get everything wrong.

item.title: Comfidence
item.description: If only the Yacuruna would have heard….If only he knew there were some hunters close by, spying their conversation. Maybe the little warrior could have enjoyed more of his jungle life. I guess The Yacuruna didn’t have super sensitive abilities as their enemies used to believe. One more proof that humans speak bullshit since the beginning of times. The truth is that Yacurunas had different abilities that goes beyond our comprehension.

item.title: Cry
item.description: “It’s ok you can cry, cry as much as you want. I know I’ve been tough, but hey, you’ve been through all, and it was all for your own good. I didn’t mean it like this, you know? It was all supposed to be like this. These are the conditions for life. Fire, suffer, intensity. We all go through this, but not all of us leave from this. It takes courage, wisdom and integration to be able to switch reality and start enjoying it.

item.title: Dark teacher
item.description: In the school of universe there are many kinds of teachers. The moon, the sun, the plants, the frogs and many more. Each one has to be treated with respect and students should approach them properly in a balanced way. Never attending to classes for no reason at all. Never overusing information or any kind of distorting, egotism, or spreading lies. Students are students for a reason, and only when they are called to the Principal, is when they can start switching to a different role.

item.title: Dreams
item.description: “I never ever had this kind of dreams, and I had all kinds. From the most random to the most rational one. But lately dreams feel different. As if they are remnants of different realities. They claim my presence. They want me there as much as this wants me. Not only that, I also want them. It’s impossible to ignore the call. The feeling of belonging and losing. Of not having each other.

item.title: Duty first
item.description: This is a dream, a small fraction of vacation for your soul. And it’s not free, and it’s not forever. That’s why you need to enjoy it as much as you can and stop overworrying in meaningless things. Deep, very deep in your soul you know it, and when you start to experience some kind of discomfort and hard situations in life is when you start remembering that you are actually doing well.

item.title: Elements
item.description: Everything you see is an expression of love. And how is love made for? You know that answer. There has to be intention, passion, intensity. The clash of mountains, the fall of trees. There is no creation that holds still. There is always movement, change. After the thunderbolt has hit and the fire is ignited, there’s no turning back. Transformation happens and the dance of time starts its number. When Gaia made love and realized her true power, her light expanded and covered everything that was in darkness.

item.title: Fear
item.description: “Fear is the biggest tool of the jerk. His name is not even worth mentioning. He will use that tool until the end of it’s days. He’s addicted to it. Expert and master of deceiving. He knows all the power in it. Fear not only changes people, but turns them against each other. Never finding a path, a way out, just running in circles, crashing themselves without a chance to stop.

item.title: Feeling Spines
item.description: There’s a medicine that if not balanced can become a curse. But the kind of curse we all should have. The curse of feeling. The feeling spines of knowledge. The cool teacher. Though less intense and popular than others, this one always comes with style. His manners are soft and likeable, but his wisdom comes in subtle ways. Only the ones truly open, the ones already waking up can fully get his teachings, the beautiful melancholy of life.

item.title: Friendship
item.description: “You can’t, they can only believe what their eyes can see. So for now be proud of what you got. Your soul knows and that’s enough. That’s what the medicine is for, so you need to find a way to protect it and when the time comes, bring them back to the source. Yes, it will be hard, cause for them to leave their egos behind, it may take them so many lives.

item.title: Interruption
item.description: “There has been an interruption to the party of life. There was love being made by the rhythm of the jungle sounds and got interrupted abruptly. Who dares to do that? Of course the same ones that have been destroying my homeland. The ones that ironically think they are special, different or less evil. They don’t realize they all come from the same place. This time it was not for survival, not by accident.

item.title: Jungle
item.description: “Do you know why I chose the jungle?. I didn’t choose the jungle. The jungle is where I was born. A raw, hard and intense environment. Perfect place for a perfect accident. What could be more ideal? Beautiful and reluctant at the same time. A place that combines fire and mist, storm and sunsets. So much life, everywhere, every second, at your ears, at your shoulders, everywhere claiming what’s theirs.

item.title: Lost
item.description: To be lost for real. That’s when the real journey starts. Of course it’s not ideal. Of course you wouldn’t want it. But this is what the accident of life is about. This is how the old makes space for the new. For growth and experiences. For love and light who is awaiting for us. No doubt and no fear can stop it. Once the call is answered there’s only time between her and us.

item.title: Love goes on
item.description: There was a man who loved women so much that even Gaia couldn’t comprehend it. Thousands of lives lived and died under many names but only one soul. Insane. The most wild, brave and independent of them all, whose passion and intensity could only be matched by creation itself. Gaia was so wise, she always knew, that she was preparing the warrior for one more job. And the warrior what? Does he have a choice?

item.title: Normal life
Party in the jungle
item.description: There is a moment in life for everything. Moments to laugh, moments for crying. Moments to learn, moments for teaching. Time for talking, time to be silent. There are special moments, and they are sacred ones. Now, when we are standing in front of Gaia. When we are in this precious moment, so important, we should be grateful and feel proudly for just being there. Life was so good to us and we were skilled enough to reach this moment of triumph.

item.title: Soul immunity
item.description: “I know you think you have failed. But this doesn’t mean this is over. You need to see the big picture and understand the task is hard, but not impossible. You know how hard was this to happen? How many lives went through multiple decisions and failures? How many accidents, coincidences, and dreams were followed to make the circumstances the way they are now? Nothing is in vane and nothing is left to randomness.

item.title: The jungle Chad
item.description: There was a jungle man who had a special ability that even Gaia got jealous of. He could see more stars than anyone else. This extreme sense of awareness would grant him advantages in hunting, leading the tribe, predicting outcomes and of course, reading girls. Born and raised in the forest, he was the most popular and the most good looking of the village. Not even Yacurunas could be faster than him, as he bragged that he defeated them many times in battle.

item.title: The meeting
The muse
item.description: “You came as the light to my darkness, the answer to my calls. You are the proof of love and what it holds. Still, you shouldn’t come with me. I carry scars and wounds that can’t be closed. The hole in my heart can only be sealed with the end of my days. Still, don’t feel bad for me. I’ve run and I’ve fought all my life. With you I got a pause, a safe spot, a retreat.

item.title: The rebel one
item.description: There’s a plant you have, in some other place in the planet. It was one of the most beloved ones from Gaia. Her favorite one, I would say. This plant is unstoppable. Is the terror of the ones who hate, or the ones who impose fear. One day, in one of your lives, you will find it, and you will unlock the current of knowledge that only the source provides.

item.title: The Warrior
item.description: Hundreds of lives have passed, hundreds of wars. A warrior lives in each of us, so better not to ignore it anymore. At times when it’s all dark and the heart hasn’t healed from many wounds, he’s the one preventing demons from knocking our doors. A voice of intuition. A voice of support. Be careful though, as many words you’ll hear won’t be of your taste at all. Still he’s the one protecting us with so much passion and strength.

item.title: The world
item.description: You want to talk about Ayahuasca? Ok we’ll talk about ayahuasca. To encapsulate a world, how would that be? Yet it seems we live on a capsule. How to explain someone about love? If this person never loved. How can a man know to love? If he never lost her love. There’s a few things in life that we can only learn by ourselves. These are the most important things to learn.

item.title: Treason
item.description: “How can it be that men believe more in themselves than in mother nature? Don’t you see every day with your eyes? Who gives the light? Who gives the day and night? Where is your respect? You have gone totally reckless and went against everything I commanded. Not only you destroy my home, where you have been invited as guests, but also start exploting the magic vine under my name.

item.title: What they want
